The Deja Brew story

Some moments deserve a second cup.

Deja Brew is a proposed cozy, welcoming café for college students and young adults who want a comfortable place to study, unwind, enjoy a solo date, or catch up with friends. We pair quality drinks and sweet treats with thoughtful touches — like handwritten affirmations and personalized cup sleeves — to make an everyday visit feel personal.

A Little Something
to Remember ♡

Purchase any eligible regular-priced drink and show the Deja Brew campaign post before payment to receive one complimentary affirmation cup sleeve, while supplies last. A small reminder to carry a kind thought with you.

One sleeve per transaction. The sleeve is not redeemable for cash, cannot be combined with other promotions, and is not valid on past purchases. This is a proposed campaign; confirm the café opening date, sleeve quantity, and final terms before publication.
